nodes.label: e2e-shards workflow
nodes.rationale: Reusable (workflow_call only) shard half of the e2e suite so e2e.yaml can call it once per Kubernetes version and the Actions UI shows a collapsible group per version. Installs kubectl matching the cluster version because the runner's kubectl tracks newest Kubernetes and would be outside the +/-1 minor skew for older matrix legs. Artifact names include shard and k8s version because upload-artifact v7 rejects duplicates.

nodes.label: Ginkgo Shard Label Partitioning
nodes.rationale: Suite is split by Ginkgo Label("shard-a"|"shard-b"|"shard-c") on framework.CasesDescribe containers: shard-a = impersonation, headers, probe; shard-b = authconfig, upgrade, audit; shard-c = passthrough, token, rbac, reserved identity. Each shard stands up its own kind cluster so wall-clock is the slowest shard, not the sum. hack/verify-e2e-shards.sh prevents an unlabelled case from silently running in no shard.
